phases.name: Serve the keystroke read path
phases.description: Establish the client and low-latency suggestion path, then connect candidate retrieval, personalization, ranking, and the response.

phases.name: Keep the corpus and user signals current
phases.description: Persist canonical suggestion changes and user feedback, then apply events to the distributed index, caches, and personalization history.

phases.name: Review matching, language, memory, and scale
phases.description: Make the recall, ranking, freshness, and partitioning tradeoffs explicit and scale from observed request behavior.

steps.phase: Serve the keystroke read path
steps.title: Keep the brief and unknowns visible
steps.content: The frozen brief requires suggestions while users type, top N relevant results, typo tolerance, personalization, real-time updates, billions of queries per day, and multiple languages. Treat the supplied <100ms limit as the user-visible keystroke-to-suggestion objective. Assume each request carries a partial query and locale, an optional opaque user key, and a requested N. The exact N policy, supported locales, personalization consent and retention policy, anonymous-user behavior, and the freshness meaning of real-time are unspecified; keep those as review decisions rather than inventing values.

steps.phase: Serve the keystroke read path
steps.title: Add the typeahead client
steps.content: Send the current partial text, locale, requested result count, and optional authenticated user key. Ignore responses for superseded input so a slow earlier prefix cannot replace newer suggestions.

component.label: Typeahead Client
component.description: Search box and suggestion list in the browser

properties.purpose: Submit partial text and locale as the user types, optionally include an authenticated opaque user key, render the returned top N suggestions, and discard stale responses when newer input has already been entered.

component.highlightReason: The existing Web App catalog component represents the browser surface without introducing a custom client type.

steps.phase: Serve the keystroke read path
steps.title: Add the request gateway
steps.content: Validate query shape and locale, apply the caller's access policy, and route suggestion reads separately from protected catalog updates. Do not put ranking work or a corpus scan in the gateway.

component.label: Typeahead API Gateway
component.description: Validated entry point for suggestion reads and catalog changes

properties.purpose: Validate partial-query and locale inputs, enforce any caller identity policy, and route high-volume suggestion reads separately from authorized catalog-update requests.

component.highlightReason: The existing API Gateway catalog component supplies the request boundary and route split.

steps.phase: Serve the keystroke read path
steps.title: Add a stateless suggestion API
steps.content: Normalize the partial query for its locale, fetch candidate and personalization signals in parallel, request ranking, and return the requested top N. Keep handlers stateless so read capacity can scale horizontally for the stated billions of queries per day.

component.label: Suggestion Read API
component.description: Stateless orchestration for each partial-query request

properties.purpose: Normalize each partial query with its locale, read cached and indexed candidates plus compact user-history signals in parallel, invoke ranking, and return the caller's requested top N without scanning the full corpus. Keep the request handler stateless for horizontal read scaling.

component.highlightReason: The existing Backend Server catalog component covers the request orchestration service.

steps.phase: Serve the keystroke read path
steps.title: Cache popular locale-aware prefixes
steps.content: Use cache-aside entries for popular normalized prefixes and their precomputed top suggestions. Keep this cache limited to non-personalized candidates; apply user-specific ranking after lookup so one user's results cannot be served to another.

component.label: Popular Prefix Cache
component.description: Bounded cache of locale and prefix keyed common candidates

properties.purpose: Cache popular locale and normalized-prefix candidate lists with precomputed top suggestions. Store only non-personalized candidates, keep user-specific ranking outside shared keys, and invalidate affected prefixes when index updates arrive.

component.highlightReason: The existing Cache catalog component supports Redis, cache-aside, and LFU settings for hot-prefix reads.

steps.phase: Serve the keystroke read path
steps.title: Add the distributed prefix index
steps.content: Represent the suggestion corpus with a compact trie or finite-state prefix index partitioned by locale and prefix range. Store ranking features and selected precomputed top descendants with entries. Use an exact-prefix fast path and a bounded typo-recovery path instead of scanning all suggestions for every partial query.

component.label: Distributed Prefix Index
component.description: Locale-partitioned suggestion terms and retrieval features

properties.purpose: Serve locale-aware partial-prefix lookups over a distributed compact trie or finite-state representation. Keep popularity and freshness features with terms, precompute top descendants only for selected hot prefixes, and support bounded fuzzy candidates for typo tolerance without a full-corpus scan.

component.highlightReason: The existing Search Engine catalog component represents indexed retrieval; the compact prefix structure remains an implementation choice rather than a custom catalog node.

steps.phase: Serve the keystroke read path
steps.title: Rank candidates for the current user
steps.content: Combine prefix and fuzzy candidates with locale, query context, popularity, freshness, and permitted user-history signals. A machine-learning ranker chooses the most relevant results; preserve a deterministic feature-based fallback if model inference is unavailable.

component.label: Suggestion Ranking Service
component.description: Personalized relevance ordering for candidate suggestions

properties.purpose: Rank only retrieved candidates using query and locale context, popularity, freshness, and permitted user-history features. Return a relevance-ordered top N with a deterministic fallback when machine-learning inference is unavailable.

component.highlightReason: The existing Recommendation catalog component is explicitly intended for ML ranking and personalization.

steps.phase: Serve the keystroke read path
steps.title: Store compact suggestion history
steps.content: Keep a compact user-keyed history of selected suggestions and eligible interactions, separate from the shared corpus. Apply the product's consent, access, and retention rules; do not put raw identity or history into shared prefix-cache entries.

component.label: Suggestion History Store

properties.purpose: Persist compact, access-controlled user-keyed suggestion history and preference features for personalized ranking. Apply product-defined consent and retention rules and keep these records out of shared prefix-cache values.

component.highlightReason: The existing Database catalog component represents durable user-specific ranking features.

steps.phase: Serve the keystroke read path
steps.title: Send partial queries to the gateway
steps.content: Carry the partial text, locale, requested N, and optional user key to the validated API boundary.

connection.label: Partial query request
connection.description: Per-keystroke suggestion request includes locale and requested result count.

steps.phase: Serve the keystroke read path
steps.title: Route suggestion reads to the API
steps.content: Keep suggestion reads on the low-latency stateless service path.

connection.label: Validated suggestion request
connection.description: Gateway routes validated partial-query reads to stateless suggestion orchestration.

steps.phase: Serve the keystroke read path
steps.title: Check popular prefix candidates first
steps.content: Use the locale and normalized prefix as the shared key and keep personalized ordering out of this cache.

connection.label: Hot-prefix lookup
connection.description: Cache-aside lookup for non-personalized candidates keyed by locale and normalized prefix.

steps.phase: Serve the keystroke read path
steps.title: Retrieve prefix and typo-tolerant candidates
steps.content: On a cache miss, use the locale-partitioned index for prefix candidates and bounded fuzzy recovery.

connection.label: Prefix candidate retrieval
connection.description: Locale-aware prefix lookup with a bounded typo-tolerant candidate path.

steps.phase: Serve the keystroke read path
steps.title: Read permitted personalization features
steps.content: Fetch compact history by opaque user key in parallel with candidate retrieval; fall back to non-personalized ranking when no eligible history is available.

connection.label: User history features
connection.description: Read only the requesting user's eligible compact features; absence or denial falls back to general relevance.

steps.phase: Serve the keystroke read path
steps.title: Submit candidate features for ranking
steps.content: Rank the bounded candidate set with locale, query, freshness, popularity, and available user-history context.

connection.label: Candidates and ranking context
connection.description: The API sends retrieved candidates and only the allowed user and locale features needed to order them.

steps.phase: Serve the keystroke read path
steps.title: Pass index features into relevance ranking
steps.content: Expose candidate popularity, freshness, locale, and prefix-match evidence to the ranker.

connection.label: Candidate relevance features
connection.description: Indexed match and freshness signals supplement request context for ranking.

steps.phase: Serve the keystroke read path
steps.title: Return the relevance-ordered top N
steps.content: Return ranked suggestions and enough match metadata for the API to apply the caller's requested N and locale-safe response format.

connection.label: Ranked candidate list
connection.description: Return relevance-ordered candidates to the orchestrator for top N response shaping.

steps.phase: Serve the keystroke read path
steps.title: Deliver suggestions to the active input
steps.content: Return the current request's ranked top N and locale-aware display values; the client ignores responses superseded by newer typing.

connection.label: Top N suggestions
connection.description: Return the ranked list for the active partial query and locale.

steps.phase: Keep the corpus and user signals current
steps.title: Add an authorized catalog update path
steps.content: Validate additions, edits, and removals of suggestion terms independently from read traffic. Commit the canonical change before publishing its event so downstream projections can recover from the durable source.

component.label: Suggestion Catalog Update Service
component.description: Authorized writes to canonical suggestion terms

properties.purpose: Validate authorized suggestion-term additions, edits, and removals; commit canonical state before publishing durable change events for online index and cache updates.

component.highlightReason: The existing Backend Server catalog component covers the separate write service without adding a custom component.

steps.phase: Keep the corpus and user signals current
steps.title: Keep canonical terms separate from the index
steps.content: Persist the authoritative suggestion corpus and change versions so the derived prefix index can be rebuilt and reconciled after failure.

component.label: Canonical Suggestion Catalog
component.description: Authoritative terms and versioned catalog state

properties.purpose: Persist authoritative suggestion terms, locale metadata, ranking inputs, and change versions. Use this source to reconcile or rebuild derived prefix-index partitions after missed or duplicate events.

component.highlightReason: The existing Database catalog component represents durable source state; the search index remains a rebuildable projection.

steps.phase: Keep the corpus and user signals current
steps.title: Buffer catalog and eligible interaction events
steps.content: Carry versioned catalog changes and privacy-filtered query or selection signals to consumers. Keep event publication off the keystroke response path and make replay and duplicate delivery safe.

component.label: Suggestion Update Event Stream
component.description: Durable change and eligible interaction events

properties.purpose: Durably buffer versioned catalog changes and minimized eligible interaction signals for asynchronous indexing and history updates. Support replay and idempotent consumption without delaying suggestion responses.

component.highlightReason: The existing Message Broker catalog component represents durable asynchronous event delivery.

steps.phase: Keep the corpus and user signals current
steps.title: Apply online index and history updates
steps.content: Consume events idempotently, update the affected locale and prefix partitions, refresh compact user-history features, and invalidate impacted precomputed prefixes. Expose consumer lag so the real-time freshness behavior can be reviewed.

component.label: Suggestion Projection Workers
component.description: Idempotent index, cache, and history projection updates

properties.purpose: Consume versioned catalog and eligible interaction events idempotently; update affected locale and prefix index partitions, compact user-history features, and hot-prefix cache invalidations. Publish consumer lag and failures so real-time freshness can be assessed.

component.highlightReason: The existing Processing Worker catalog component covers asynchronous projection maintenance.

steps.phase: Keep the corpus and user signals current
steps.title: Route protected term changes separately
steps.content: The gateway sends authorized catalog mutations to the write service, leaving the suggestion read path independently scalable.

connection.label: Authorized catalog mutations
connection.description: Protected additions, edits, and removals use the separate catalog write route.

steps.phase: Keep the corpus and user signals current
steps.title: Commit canonical changes first
steps.content: Persist the authoritative version before announcing it to the projection stream.

connection.label: Versioned canonical terms
connection.description: Catalog writes update durable source state before projection events are emitted.

steps.phase: Keep the corpus and user signals current
steps.title: Publish catalog changes for online projection
steps.content: Emit the committed version and affected locale or prefix keys so consumers can update only the impacted partitions and cached prefixes.

connection.label: Committed catalog changes
connection.description: Versioned update events identify affected locale and prefix projections.

steps.phase: Keep the corpus and user signals current
steps.title: Record eligible feedback off the read path
steps.content: Publish minimized, policy-approved interaction signals asynchronously; do not make a suggestion response wait for analytics or personalization writes.

connection.label: Eligible query and selection signals
connection.description: Asynchronous privacy-filtered feedback supports popularity and personalization projections without blocking the response.

steps.phase: Keep the corpus and user signals current
steps.title: Deliver replayable events to projection workers
steps.content: Allow retries and replay while making each catalog or feedback update idempotent at the consumer.

connection.label: Catalog and interaction events
connection.description: Durable delivery with retry, replay, and consumer-side deduplication.

steps.phase: Keep the corpus and user signals current
steps.title: Update affected prefix partitions
steps.content: Apply catalog and popularity changes online to the locale and prefix partitions that own the affected terms.

connection.label: Locale and prefix index updates
connection.description: Idempotent online updates to affected distributed suggestion-index partitions.

steps.phase: Keep the corpus and user signals current
steps.title: Invalidate changed hot-prefix results
steps.content: Invalidate or refresh only cache entries affected by an update so precomputed top suggestions do not hide newly relevant terms.

connection.label: Targeted hot-prefix invalidation
connection.description: Refresh or evict cached prefixes affected by versioned index updates.

steps.phase: Keep the corpus and user signals current
steps.title: Project eligible interactions into user history
steps.content: Update compact user-keyed ranking features with idempotent event handling and the product's approved data policy.

connection.label: Personalization feature updates
connection.description: Eligible query and selection events maintain compact per-user ranking history.

steps.phase: Keep the corpus and user signals current
steps.title: Reconcile projections from canonical state
steps.content: Read versioned canonical records to repair missed updates and rebuild an index partition without treating the derived index as the source of truth.

connection.label: Rebuild and reconciliation reads
connection.description: Workers recover derived partitions from the versioned canonical catalog.

steps.phase: Review matching, language, memory, and scale
steps.title: Bound typo recovery behind prefix matching
steps.content: Use exact prefix retrieval first and invoke typo-tolerant matching only over a bounded candidate path. This keeps fuzzy matching useful without turning every partial query into an expensive corpus-wide edit-distance search.

decision.question: How should the system trade typo recall against keystroke latency?
decision.chosen: Use locale-aware exact prefix matching first, then bounded fuzzy recovery when prefix evidence is weak.
decision.chosenReason: The fast path serves ordinary typing while a limited typo path adds recall without an unbounded scan.

alternatives.option: Run edit-distance matching against the full corpus for every keystroke
alternatives.tradeoff: It may recover more variants but consumes read work and threatens the supplied latency objective.
It is simpler and compact but does not meet the brief's typo-tolerance requirement.

steps.phase: Review matching, language, memory, and scale
steps.title: Keep matching and ranking language-aware
steps.content: Normalize Unicode and tokenize with locale-aware rules while preserving display text. Partition index data by locale and keep ranking signals language-appropriate; do not assume English tokenization or mix locales unless product behavior explicitly calls for fallback.

decision.question: How should partial queries behave across multiple languages?
decision.chosen: Carry locale through normalization, index lookup, typo recovery, and ranking, with an explicit product-owned fallback policy.
decision.chosenReason: Locale-specific processing avoids applying one language's token and ranking rules to another while keeping the fallback behavior reviewable.

alternatives.option: Use one English-oriented analyzer for every query
alternatives.tradeoff: It is operationally simpler but can break token boundaries, normalization, and relevance in other languages.

alternatives.option: Search every locale partition for every partial query
alternatives.tradeoff: It can broaden recall but adds unnecessary fanout and mixes results without an explicit cross-language product rule.

steps.phase: Review matching, language, memory, and scale
steps.title: Spend memory only on useful prefixes
steps.content: Compress shared prefixes in trie or finite-state segments and precompute descendants only for selected hot prefixes. Keep the cache bounded and let colder prefixes use the index, balancing memory use against recomputation and freshness work.

decision.question: How much prefix state should be precomputed and cached?
decision.chosen: Use compressed shared-prefix structures and selectively precompute and cache popular prefixes.
decision.chosenReason: This reuses common prefix storage and reduces repeated hot reads without retaining a full top-list expansion for every possible prefix.

alternatives.option: Materialize top suggestions for every prefix
alternatives.tradeoff: Reads become simpler but memory use and update fanout grow with the corpus and language set.

alternatives.option: Compute every result only from the full index at request time
alternatives.tradeoff: It minimizes precomputed state but repeats work for popular prefixes and adds read-path cost.

steps.phase: Review matching, language, memory, and scale
steps.title: Scale reads from observed query shape
steps.content: Billions of queries per day describe aggregate demand but not its peak shape, locale mix, prefix skew, or cache behavior. Measure those inputs before choosing capacity or partition boundaries.

scaleTrigger.metric: Observed read volume, request saturation, cache hits and misses, prefix and locale skew, index-partition health, and consumer lag
scaleTrigger.action: Scale stateless API capacity and distribute or rebalance locale and prefix partitions when measured demand or skew requires it; replicate hot partitions where that relieves a demonstrated read bottleneck.
scaleTrigger.impact: Supports high read throughput at the stated daily query scale while tying capacity and memory cost to observed traffic rather than an invented peak estimate.

steps.phase: Review matching, language, memory, and scale
steps.title: Protect the supplied end-to-end latency objective
steps.content: Measure keystroke-to-response latency across cache hits, index misses, fuzzy recovery, and personalization. Fetch candidates and compact history in parallel, keep the fuzzy branch bounded, and use the supplied <100ms requirement as the acceptance boundary; the brief does not define a percentile or measurement environment.

scaleTrigger.metric: End-to-end response latency by cache-hit and cache-miss path, locale, fuzzy-match path, and personalization availability
scaleTrigger.action: Profile the slow path, reduce repeated work, rebalance hot index partitions, and agree the percentile and measurement environment with product owners while meeting the supplied latency boundary.
scaleTrigger.impact: Keeps relevance, typo recovery, and personalization visible in latency review instead of optimizing only the easiest cache-hit case.

steps.phase: Review matching, language, memory, and scale
steps.title: Review freshness and degraded behavior
steps.content: Treat the canonical catalog as authoritative and the trie index, hot-prefix cache, and user features as recoverable projections. Replay versioned events idempotently after worker failures, reconcile from canonical state, and expose event lag because the brief does not define a numeric freshness bound. If personalization or model inference is unavailable, return general relevance from indexed candidates; if an index partition is unhealthy, route to a healthy replica or report reduced coverage rather than silently serving stale personalized data. Confirm consent, retention, supported locales, requested-N policy, and the real-time freshness meaning before considering this local review draft publishable.
